newsitem.title: PERU: Lima bolsa announces Backus stock split.
newsitem.headline: Lima bolsa announces Backus stock split.

text.p: Peru's top brewery group Union de Cervecerias Peruanas Backus y Johnston SA will carry out a stock split to issue an extra 0.12968 of a share for every one currently in circulation, the Lima bolsa said Thursday.
All shareholders of Backus stock as of June 30 will receive extra shares on July 21, the Lima Stock Exchange said in its daily report. It gave no reasons for the split.
The bolsa also said Backus had completed a $100 million deal with investment bank J.P. Morgan to refinance debt. Backus will have one year's grace before paying the loan off over four years.

Backus group shareholders created Unin de Cerveceras Peruanas Backus y Johnston SA by merging Cervecera Backus y Johnston with its three sister companies Compaa Nacional de Cerveza SA, Sociedad Cervecera de Trujillo SA and Cervecera del Norte SA. The merger took place on December 30, 1996.
The merged companies' stock is a blue chip on the bolsa.
